comment: The connector caller token wire, cct2 (ADR 0239 'Bundle, identity and request contract' item 2; the run and work_item pair and the deadline bound stand from ADR 0178; cross-language parity per ADR 0194). The worker mints one per sandbox boot (apps/worker/src/curie_worker/caller_token.py), the runner presents it in the X-Curie-Caller header, and the caller proxy verifies it (apps/worker/src/curie_connector_proxy/caller.py); cli/src/connector_caller.rs mirrors both halves in Rust. Readers: apps/worker/tests/test_connector_caller_token.py, apps/worker/tests/test_connector_caller_verify.py, apps/worker/tests/test_connector_proxy.py, apps/worker/tests/test_connector_proxy_upstream_host.py, cli/tests/connector_caller_token.rs and cli/tests/connector_caller_keys.rs; each rejects an unknown key so a key added for one reader cannot pass vacuously. Token: `cct2.<payload>.<signature>`. payload is the unpadded base64url of json.dumps(claims, separators=(',', ':'), sort_keys=True) with ensure_ascii (lowercase \u escapes, surrogate pairs above the BMP); signature is the unpadded base64url of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the ASCII bytes of `cct2.<payload>`. Claims are exactly {agent, agent_id, exp, installation} or that plus {run, work_item}. installation is opaque text, blank (dedicated standalone execution only) or 1 to `max_installation_bytes` UTF-8 bytes that contain no surrogate and no code point in `installation_forbidden` (ADR 0239: general category Cc plus Unicode White_Space, written out as inclusive [first, last] code point ranges so no reader depends on a Unicode table version; U+FEFF, which is Cf, is accepted); the resolver's installation_ok applies the same rule. It is compared exactly, with no normalization, and never parsed as a UUID. agent_id, run and work_item are lowercase hyphenated UUIDs. agent is the nonempty display name, verbatim. exp is a JSON integer in 0..=2**63-1, absolute unix seconds; a token is valid while exp > now. No string claim carries a lone surrogate. Verification order: length <= `max_token_chars` and ASCII; three segments with prefix exactly cct2; canonical unpadded base64url segments; a 64-byte signature verified by any configured key before anything is parsed; ASCII payload bytes; JSON with duplicate keys and NaN/Infinity refused; exact key set; field rules. Dedicated mode: missing, invalid, expired, then not_admitted against an exact admits list; installation is not compared and may be blank. Shared mode: missing; a blank or invalid configured installation refuses every token as invalid; invalid; a blank claim installation is invalid; a different installation is not_admitted; then expired. `vectors` are minted byte for byte by every minter (Ed25519 is deterministic); `seed` and `public` are standard base64 of the 32-byte seed and public key the chart's Secret holds. `decisions` give `public` (configured keys), `token` (null for no header), `mode`, `now`, the expected `refusal` (null when admitted) and, when admitted, the exact `claims`. Every decision token is validly signed by a vector seed unless the case is about the signature, key or token text, so only the named rule refuses it. `mint_refusals` give claims every minter must refuse; the text <U+D800> in a string stands for a lone U+D800 the reader substitutes (JSON readers cannot carry one), and an exp outside a reader's integer type is refused at that type's boundary. Generated independently with PyNaCl, not with the code under test. Every token (`minted` and decision `token`) is stored as its "."-separated segments, exactly token.split("."), so no single high-entropy token string appears in the corpus, and readers join them with ".".

vectors.name: a_plain_agent_name
vectors.why: The common case: a cluster installation id (32 alphanumerics, the chart's generated value), the agent UUID, a deploy.yaml-shaped agent name and a far expiry.

vectors.name: the_same_claims_under_another_seed
vectors.why: The payload is identical and only the signature moves, so a verifier that checked the payload and skipped the signature would accept both.

vectors.name: a_stored_name_outside_the_bundle_shape_is_carried_verbatim
vectors.why: The API stores agent names wider than deploy.yaml accepts. The claim carries the stored display name as it is, and the lowercase \u escapes pin one encoding of it.

vectors.name: an_astral_display_name_is_escaped_as_a_surrogate_pair
vectors.why: Python's ensure_ascii writes a character above the BMP as a lowercase surrogate pair escape; a hand-written minter must produce the same bytes.

vectors.name: a_display_name_with_json_short_escapes
vectors.why: Quote, backslash and the control characters Python writes as short escapes (\b \f \n \r \t), other control characters and DEL written as lowercase \u00XX, and slash written raw. Pins the canonical escaping a hand-written minter must copy.

vectors.name: a_work_item_run
vectors.why: ADR 0178: run and work_item ride with the identity claims as a pair. A verifier that skipped run would not see this payload differ from the next vector.

vectors.name: the_same_work_item_under_another_run
vectors.why: The payload differs from a_work_item_run only in run, so a verifier that ignored that claim would accept both as one.

vectors.name: a_blank_installation_for_a_dedicated_standalone_worker
vectors.why: A dedicated standalone worker has installation_id "". The minter accepts it and the dedicated verifier admits it; the shared verifier refuses it as invalid.

vectors.name: an_uppercase_uuid_shaped_secret_uid_installation_is_opaque_text
vectors.why: A Kubernetes Secret UID can be the installation id. It is never parsed or lowercased as a UUID: the claim carries it byte for byte.

vectors.name: an_installation_of_exactly_128_ascii_characters
vectors.why: The installation bound is 128 UTF-8 bytes, inclusive: 128 ASCII characters, punctuation included, compared exactly.

vectors.name: an_installation_with_an_nfc_e_acute
vectors.why: U+00E9 in NFC is neither Cc nor White_Space; the installation is not limited to ASCII.

vectors.name: an_installation_with_an_astral_character
vectors.why: U+10000 is above the BMP and neither Cc nor White_Space; ensure_ascii writes it as a lowercase surrogate pair escape.

vectors.name: an_installation_with_u_1c89
vectors.why: U+1C89 is accepted because the rule is an enumerated set, not a printability table that Python and Rust disagree on.

vectors.name: an_installation_with_a_byte_order_mark_u_feff
vectors.why: U+FEFF is Cf, neither Cc nor White_Space, so the ADR's rule accepts it.

vectors.name: an_installation_of_128_multibyte_utf8_bytes
vectors.why: 64 copies of U+00E9 are exactly 128 UTF-8 bytes, the inclusive bound.

decisions.name: admitted_dedicated
decisions.why: The baseline: a validly signed token, an admitted agent, before expiry.

decisions.name: admitted_shared
decisions.why: The same token in shared mode: the claim installation equals the configured one exactly.

decisions.name: admitted_shared_with_a_run_pair
decisions.why: A run pair rides through the shared verifier untouched.

decisions.name: admitted_under_either_configured_key
decisions.why: Two configured keys overlap a rotation: a token signed by the second seed is admitted.

decisions.name: exp_at_the_signed_64_bit_maximum_is_admitted
decisions.why: exp 2**63-1 is the top of the closed range both Python and a Rust i64 reader hold losslessly.

decisions.name: a_blank_installation_is_admitted_by_the_dedicated_verifier
decisions.why: Dedicated execution does not compare installation, and a standalone worker signs it blank.

decisions.name: a_token_of_exactly_4096_chars_is_admitted
decisions.why: The 4096-character bound is inclusive: this validly signed token sits on it.

decisions.name: a_validly_signed_token_over_4096_chars_is_invalid
decisions.why: The length bound applies before any decoding, even to a token whose signature verifies.

decisions.name: no_token_is_missing
decisions.why: No header at all.

decisions.name: an_empty_token_is_missing
decisions.why: An empty header value is no token.

decisions.name: no_token_is_missing_in_shared_mode_even_with_a_blank_configured_installation
decisions.why: Missing is decided before the configured installation is checked.

decisions.name: a_blank_configured_installation_refuses_every_token
decisions.why: Shared execution fails closed when its own installation is blank.

decisions.name: a_blank_configured_installation_refuses_a_nonblank_token
decisions.why: Shared execution fails closed when its own installation is blank.

decisions.name: an_invalid_configured_installation_refuses_every_token
decisions.why: A configured installation that breaks the rule (a space) fails closed, even against a token carrying the same text.

decisions.name: a_blank_claim_installation_is_invalid_in_shared_mode
decisions.why: Blank installation is only meaningful for dedicated standalone execution.

decisions.name: a_foreign_installation_is_not_admitted
decisions.why: Another installation's validly signed token.

decisions.name: a_uuid_shaped_installation_is_compared_exactly_not_lowercased
decisions.why: The configured value is the lowercase spelling of the signed uppercase Secret UID; no UUID folding.

decisions.name: a_uuid_shaped_installation_matching_exactly_is_admitted
decisions.why: The same uppercase text configured is admitted.

decisions.name: a_128_character_installation_matching_exactly_is_admitted_in_shared_mode
decisions.why: An installation at the bound compares byte for byte.

decisions.name: a_foreign_installation_outranks_expiry_in_shared_mode
decisions.why: Shared order: installation mismatch is decided before expiry.

decisions.name: shared_mode_has_no_admits_list
decisions.why: A display name no dedicated list names is still admitted when the installation matches.

decisions.name: shared_mode_expired
decisions.why: Shared mode refuses a token at its expiry.

decisions.name: an_agent_off_the_list_is_not_admitted
decisions.why: Dedicated admission is the admits list.

decisions.name: the_admits_match_is_exact
decisions.why: No case folding: ACME-DEV does not admit acme-dev.

decisions.name: an_empty_admits_list_admits_nobody
decisions.why: An empty list admits no one.

decisions.name: dedicated_expiry_outranks_admission
decisions.why: Dedicated order: expired is decided before admission.

decisions.name: dedicated_mode_ignores_installation
decisions.why: A foreign-looking installation is not compared in dedicated mode.

decisions.name: exp_equal_to_now_is_expired
decisions.why: Valid only while exp > now.

decisions.name: exp_before_now_is_expired
decisions.why: Past its expiry.

decisions.name: exp_zero_at_now_zero_is_expired
decisions.why: exp 0 is in range, and 0 > 0 is false.

decisions.name: exp_two_to_the_63_is_invalid
decisions.why: One past the signed 64-bit maximum.

decisions.name: exp_two_to_the_64_is_invalid
decisions.why: Out of range.

decisions.name: exp_two_to_the_64_plus_one_is_invalid
decisions.why: Out of range; also past u64.

decisions.name: exp_negative_is_invalid
decisions.why: The range starts at 0.

decisions.name: exp_negative_zero_is_invalid
decisions.why: Python reads -0 as integer 0 and serde_json as a float; both readers refuse any integer literal starting with a minus.

decisions.name: exp_in_exponent_form_is_invalid
decisions.why: 1e3 is a JSON number but not an integer literal.

decisions.name: exp_nan_is_invalid
decisions.why: NaN is not JSON; Python's parse_constant must refuse it.

decisions.name: exp_as_a_string_is_invalid
decisions.why: A string is not an integer.

decisions.name: exp_as_a_float_is_invalid
decisions.why: 1790000000.0 is not an integer literal.

decisions.name: exp_as_a_bool_is_invalid
decisions.why: true is not an integer, though Python's bool subclasses int.

decisions.name: an_unknown_field_is_invalid
decisions.why: The key set is exact.

decisions.name: a_missing_agent_is_invalid
decisions.why: agent is mandatory.

decisions.name: a_missing_agent_id_is_invalid
decisions.why: agent_id is mandatory.

decisions.name: a_missing_exp_is_invalid
decisions.why: exp is mandatory.

decisions.name: a_missing_installation_is_invalid
decisions.why: installation is mandatory.

decisions.why: run and work_item are a pair (ADR 0178).

decisions.name: a_lone_work_item_is_invalid
decisions.why: run and work_item are a pair (ADR 0178).

decisions.why: One spelling: lowercase hyphenated.

decisions.why: One spelling: lowercase hyphenated.
